name: cpu_freq_lock
cmd: for c in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu[0-9]*/cpufreq; do [ -d $c ] || continue; echo $khz > $c/scaling_min_freq 2>/dev/null; echo $khz > $c/scaling_max_freq 2>/dev/null; done; for c in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu[0-9]*/cpufreq; do [ -d $c ] || continue; echo -n "$c cur="; cat $c/scaling_cur_freq; done
